summary: Renamed billingUrl to billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and updated core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports (reports also used it) in one mono PR (#1, merged, CI and CD green). Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no version bump or lockfile change was needed. libs-platform-kit has no reference to billingUrl and does not depend on shared-contracts, so PLAT-102-4 needed no change and no PR or release. Billing's platform-kit dependency was left as is.
